description: Generates vendor artifacts from the governed CoreModels graph. For dbt: a schema.yml with enforced model contracts — column data types, not_null/unique constraints and tests, accepted_values tests from governed taxonomies, relationships tests from governed references. SMEs change meaning once in CoreModels; engineers get a reviewed contract diff.

iriInDescription.description: dbt: also append bound ontology IRIs to the column description so persist_docs carries them into the warehouse column comment. Default true; they always ride in meta regardless.

layout.description: dbt file layout: 'model' (default) one property file per model colocated with its .sql; 'folder' one file per model directory; 'single' one repo-wide file.

targetVersion.description: Vendor dialect/version. dbt: default emits data_tests: (>=1.8); '1.7' emits legacy tests:.

typeNames.description: Restrict generation to these model/type names (empty = everything eligible).

name: generate_vendor_artifacts
title: Generate Vendor Artifacts
